title: Limbus E.G.O Weapons
description: Limbus Company weapons for Fabric and Papper— projectile launchers, lifesteal, combo attacks, and passive auras, all faithfully recreated in Minecraft 1.21.4.
body:
# ⚔️ Limbus E.G.O Weapons — Wield the Power of the Sinners

> *"The City never sleeps. Neither do we."*

Bring the iconic weapons of **Limbus Company** into Minecraft with fully custom mechanics, unique attack patterns, and faithful ability recreations. This is not just a cosmetic mod — every weapon fights differently.

---

## 🗡️ The Arsenal

### 莊嚴哀悼 — Solemn Lament *(Black & White)*
> Epic · Projectile Weapon · Requires Butterfly Quartz ammunition

Two variants of Don Quixote's legendary lance, each firing a fast-moving projectile on **right-click** that consumes one **Butterfly Quartz**.

| Version | Damage | Effect |
|---------|--------|--------|
| ⚫ Black | 8 dmg | Wither II for 4 seconds |
| ⚪ White | 4 dmg | Blindness for 3 seconds |

Cooldown: **1.2 seconds**. Projectiles despawn after **5 seconds**.

> 🦋 **Butterfly Quartz** — the dedicated ammo, stackable to 64. Craft or obtain it to keep the barrage going.

---

### 聖宣盾牌 — Solemn Shield
> Rare · Passive Aura · Main Hand or Off Hand

An ever-present threat. Simply **holding** this shield emits a constant white particle aura and applies **Slowness II (2s)** to **all mobs within 5 blocks** every 5 ticks — no input required.

*Control the battlefield before the fight even begins.*

---

### 擬態 — Mimicry
> Epic · +12 Attack Damage / -3.2 Attack Speed · Lifesteal

Rodion's hammer doesn't just hit — it **devours**.

- Every strike **restores HP equal to 25% of the damage dealt**
- **10% chance** per hit to trigger a critical strike dealing **40–90 bonus damage** (randomised) with explosive particles

High risk, high reward. Land every hit.

---

### DaCapo
> Epic · +7 Attack Damage / -2.4 Attack Speed · Combo System

Yi Sang's cane replaces the standard attack with a **multi-hit combo** that also damages mobs within **3.5 blocks** at 70% damage:

| Mode | Chance | Hits | Damage/hit | Interval |
|------|--------|------|-----------|----------|
| Normal | 60% | 5 | 4 | 2 ticks |
| Special | 40% | 3 | 17 | 4 ticks |

A conductor's precision — or a maestro's fury.

---

### 環指筆刷 — Ring Brush
> Epic · +8 Attack Damage / -2.4 Attack Speed · Debuff & Dash

Liu Association's signature weapon rewards aggression:

- **Right-click** deals 3.5 damage and applies a **random debuff** (Blindness / Slowness / Poison / Weakness / Wither · 4 seconds)
- **Right-click again within 1.5 seconds** on the same target → the debuff triggers **twice**
- The first right-click **dashes you toward the target**

Chain your clicks. Chain their suffering.

---

## 🔧 Commands (OP required)

| Command | Item |
|---------|------|
| `/getego black` | Solemn Lament (Black) |
| `/getego white` | Solemn Lament (White) |
| `/getego butterflies` | Butterfly Quartz ×16 |
| `/getego shield` | Solemn Shield |
| `/getego mimicry` | Mimicry |
| `/getego dacapo` | DaCapo |
| `/getego brush` | Ring Brush |

---

## 📦 Installation

### Fabric Mod
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
2. Drop `limbus-ego-weapons-fabric-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder
3. Launch the game — the weapons are ready

**Requirements:** Fabric Loader 0.16.9 · Fabric API 0.119.4+1.21.4 · Java 21

---

### ✦Plugin ver. — Limbus E.G.O Gifts
Want your papper server to go with your weapons? Install the **Paper plugin** for Limbus Company experience:

1. Drop `LimbusEGOGift.jar` into your server's `plugins/` folder
2. Start the server — the resource pack is pushed to players automatically
3. Run `/getgift menu` to receive the accessory panel opener *(kept on death)*
4. Place a chest, look at it, and run `/gachachest set` to create a Gacha Chest
5. Distribute **Lunacy** with `/getgift lunacy <amount>` and let players draw

**Source:** [Limbus-E.G.O-Gifts](https://github.com/EvansGoethe/Limbus-E.G.O-Gifts) · Requires Paper 1.21.4
